'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[Houthi attacks on commercial vessels]]
****[[Attacks on the Eternity C|Attacks on the ''Eternity C'']]
*****At least four people are killed, two people are injured and two other people are missing after the {{MV|Eternity C||2}}, a [[Liberia]]n flagged ship, is attacked in the [[Red Sea]] near [[Hodeida]], [[Yemen]], by multiple [[Houthis|Houthi]] boats and [[drone warfare|drones]]. The ship later sinks. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2574098-opnieuw-schip-in-rode-zee-aangevallen-houthi-s-claimen-eerdere-aanval (NOS)] [https://nos.nl/artikel/2574293-schip-op-rode-zee-gezonken-na-aanval-door-houthi-s-bemanning-te-water (NOS)]
***[[Israeli attacks on Yemen (May 2025–present)|Israeli attacks on Yemen]]
****The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes three ports and a power plant in [[Houthi-controlled Yemen]] in response to recent [[ballistic missile]] attacks on [[Israel]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/israeli-forces-strike-ports-yemen-galaxy-leader-ship/story?id=123523562 (ABC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-says-it-will-strike-yemeni-ports-issues-evacuation-warning-2025-07-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[Ukrainian Armed Forces]] launch a long-range drone strike on [[Krasnodar Krai]], Russia, damaging the main [[oil refinery]] in [[Ilsky]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drone-strike-hits-major-oil-refinery-in-russias-krasnodar-krai-06-2025/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] launches over 100 [[drone warfare|drones]] at areas across [[Ukraine]], killing ten civilians and injuring 38 others. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/russia-fires-over-100-drones-at-ukraine-killing-at-least-10-civilians-authorities-say (PBS)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab militants]] recapture [[Moqokori]], a town in the [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiiraan]] region of [[Somalia]]. The heavy fighting resulted in the deaths of at least 40 [[Somali National Army]] and [[Ma'awisley]] fighters. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/heavy-fighting-and-car-bombs-as-al-shabaab-captures-key-somali-town (Garowe Online)]
*[[2025 Kenyan protests]]
**Eleven people are killed and 29 others are injured in clashes with [[Kenya Defence Forces|security forces]] amid ongoing anti-[[Government of Kenya|government]] protests in [[Kenya]], according to the [[Kenya National Commission on Human Rights|National Commission on Human Rights]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/ten-killed-in-kenya-as-protesters-clash-with-police-13393764 (Sky News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/kenya-human-rights-watchdog-says-10-killed-29-hurt-anti-government-protests-2025-07-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**Over 70 vigilante group members are killed and others are missing in an [[ambush]] by bandits in two villages in [[Kanam, Nigeria|Kanam]] and [[Wase, Nigeria|Wase]], [[Plateau State]], [[Nigeria]]. Operation Safe Haven (OPSH) denied the initial account and reported eight deaths and several missing. [https://dailypost.ng/2025/07/08/bandits-ambush-kill-over-70-vigilante-members-in-plateau/ (''Daily Post'')] [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2025/07/plateau-ambush-8-vigilantes-killed-several-missing-says-military/ (''Vanguard News'')] [https://punchng.com/eight-vigilantes-killed-in-plateau-ambush-says-military/ (''The Punch'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Paschal Donohoe]] is re-elected [[President of the Eurogroup]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2025/0707/1522274-paschal-donohoe-eurogroup/ (RTE.ie)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2025 Central Texas floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flooding]] in [[Central Texas|Central]] [[Texas]], [[United States]], increases to 104, including 28 children, with 41 other people still missing. [[Flash flood]] warnings are issued for expected additional rainfall. [https://apnews.com/article/texas-flash-flood-severe-weather-camp-mystic-ef8e596833b145fef61451db92f32609 (AP)]
*{{ill|Ramses Exchange fire|ar|حريق سنترال رمسيس}}
**Four people are killed and at least 22 others are injured in a fire at the [[Ramses Exchange]] building in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. National connectivity data is brought down to 62% of ordinary levels, including banking and phone calls. Trading on the [[Cairo Stock Exchange]] is halted the following day. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2574150-doden-bij-brand-in-datacentrum-cairo-internetverkeer-geraakt (NOS)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/07/08/africa/cairo-telecom-fire-internet-phone-disruption-intl (CNN)]
*Four people are killed, including two children, when a [[Cirrus SR22]] crashes into a field near [[Raleigh Executive Jetport]] in [[Sanford, North Carolina|Sanford]], [[North Carolina]], [[United States]]. [https://abc11.com/post/small-plane-crashes-lee-county/17005354/ (WTVD-TV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021–2022 Luzon sabungero disappearances|2021–2022 Luzon ''sabungero'' disappearances]]
**[[Philippine National Police|Philippine police]] chief [[Nicolas Torre]] announces that 15 police officers have been arrested for their alleged involvement in abducting and killing at least 34 [[cockfighting|cockfighters]] across [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]], from 2021 to 2022. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-police-missing-cockfighters-6148f7b898920c4d33bc9257c405d436 (AP)]
*[[2023 Leongatha mushroom murders]]
**Erin Patterson is found guilty on all charges regarding deaths from ''[[Amanita]]'' poisoning from a lunch at her home in [[Leongatha]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-07-07/erin-patterson-mushroom-murder-trial-verdict-live-blog/105477452 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Amnesty International]] says that [[Saudi Arabia]] executed a record 345 people last year, many of them over drug offenses. [https://apnews.com/article/saudi-arabia-executions-amnesty-report-65c045ef70efbec66b944e206a13c63b (AP)]
*[[Death of Jeffrey Epstein]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice]] announces that the alleged "Epstein client list" does not exist, in contradiction of Attorney General [[Pam Bondi]]'s claims of possessing it, and reaffirms that [[Jeffrey Epstein]]'s death was suicide. [https://apnews.com/article/jeffrey-epstein-justice-department-pam-bondi-03fbcd024f631440f7ed62b3c6927db3 (AP)]
*The perpetrator is killed and three people, two police officers and a [[border guard]], are injured in a [[mass shooting]] when a man opens fire on [[List of law enforcement agencies in Texas|law enforcement officers]] before being fatally shot at a [[US Border Patrol|Border Patrol]] facility in [[McAllen, Texas|McAllen]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/07/us/border-patrol-mcallen-shooting (CNN)]

[https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10525828 (''The Korea Herald'')]
*[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] dismisses [[Ministry of Transport (Russia)|Minister of Transport]] [[Roman Starovoyt]], with his deputy [[Andrey Nikitin (politician)|Andrey Nikitin]] replacing him. Hours after his dismissal, Starovoyt is found dead from a [[suicide|self-inflicted gunshot]].
